messages:
laura_sales: Quick sync — Zenith deal preheat ops + open blockers. Customer target: ~6k qps for embeddings at peak, budget wants p50 ~90ms. They're asking for reserved GPUs + 2 burst credits for spikes. Can we confirm an autoscale policy, KV warmup window, and whether 8 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs + 2 burst credits is viable? CC @michael_sre @sam_eng @olivia_se

michael_sre: in principle ok, but need a quick sim. 6k qps embeddings depends heavily on model and batch sizes. if they use a quantized embed model (lf-embed-q4), 8 GPUs is in the right ballpark for sustained load.

michael_sre: quick config I'd propose:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 8
  max_replicas: 12
  preheat: true
  kv_warmup: 30m
  burst_credits: 2
```

michael_sre: note: burst credits are consumed while we spin extra capacity; they don't extend KV warmup. if spikes are >30% above sustained for >5m we should auto-fallback to quantized-variant routing.

sam_eng: +1 on quantized fallback. suggest model routing rules: prefer lf-embed-q4 for sustained, route to lf-embed-1 for highest quality when capacity allows. Also recommend we prewarm prefix cache for their common prompts — that cuts tail latency a fair bit.

olivia_se: security/questionnaire update: they returned the vendor questionnaire with SOC2 attestation filled. Outstanding: KMS key exchange (they require customer-managed CMK), and we need SAML metadata for SCIM provisioning. I sent the KMS steps doc earlier (link: https://redwood.ai/kms-onboard). ETA from them: EOD tomorrow.

laura_sales: price check — if we offer 8 reserved + 2 burst credits, what's expected monthly burn? want a number to put in the term sheet.

jane_finance: rough estimate (ballpark): 8 reserved A100-equivalents ~ $72k/mo (commit rate) + burst credits are metered. Each burst credit ~ equivalent of 1.5 GPUs for 1h, so 2 credits ~ variable; recommend adding a 10% buffer. final quote will come from sales ops.

michael_sre: ops notes: preheat timeline — we need 24h notice to fully KV-warm for large prefix sets; partial warm (hot prefixes only) can be done in ~2h via targeted preheat API. If they want predictable p50, schedule full preheat 48h before launch.

sam_eng: failure mode plan: if reserved pool saturates, flow should be:
- route low-priority inference to quantized-variant
- shed best-effort batch-y requests
- if still saturated, spill to region fallback (adds latency)
I'll draft a 1-page runbook with thresholds (CPU/GPU util >85% for 3m triggers).

laura_sales: sounds good. Olivia — if KMS + SAML land by EOD tomorrow, we can finalize preheat schedule. I'll update the customer with: 8 reserved + 2 burst, autoscale policy w/ kv_warmup 30m, full preheat 48h before go-live, and runbook with graceful fallbacks.

olivia_se: confirmed I'll ping them again for CMK and SAML.

deploy-bot: Reminder: open preheat ticket required for targeted KV population — create ticket with tag `deal/zenith` and desired prefixes.

laura_sales: I'll create the ticket and share the link. Thanks team — I'll assemble the term sheet and runbook and share for sign-off. :thumbsup:

michael_sre: if you want I can run a quick synthetic load tomorrow morning to validate the 8 GPU assumption. ping me when ticket exists.

laura_sales: please do — ping sent when ticket created. thanks! :raised_hands:
